guidance.sentence: Net income attributable to common stockholders guidance has been revised to a range of $3.31 to $3.37 per diluted share from the previous range of $3.11 to $3.19.
We also increased the guidance range of full year normalized FFO attributable to common stockholders to a range of $6.47 to $6.53 per diluted share from the previous range of $6.36 to $6.44.

summary: Welltower raised its 2026 outlook, with net income attributable to common stockholders now $3.31 to $3.37 per diluted share and normalized FFO $6.47 to $6.53 per diluted share, supported by expected blended SSNOI growth of 15.0% to 16.25%.
